items: A print run for a friend's zine

content.text: Twenty years of making things, most of them by hand first.
I've been making things — collages, zines, posters, album layouts, brand systems, and whatever a client actually needed — for about twenty years now.
I trained as a designer first, which is probably why even the photography leans toward composition and light over spontaneity.

image.alt: Studio portrait from the Aveda Studio series

content.text: Most projects start on paper, not because it's precious but because it's faster to throw away.
